description: Defines the TFAccessToken entity class for two-factor authentication tokens, including creation, validation, and conversion to data transfer objects.

classes.name: TFAccessToken
classes.description: Entity class representing a two-factor authentication access token with creation, validation, and conversion methods.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new TFAccessToken with specified token string, user, and token lifetime in seconds.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the token is currently valid based on enabled status and validity period.

methods.name: toTokenData
methods.description: Converts the TFAccessToken to an AccessTokenData object with token and validity period.
